---
title: "Naming and service discovery"
---

*Sample chapter for the proposed course plan.*

## Learning outcome

Separate a logical service name from a changing network address.

**Prerequisites:** Lectures 02–03.

## Core idea

A logical service name lets callers refer to a service without embedding the address of a particular process. Discovery maps that name to an address. Cached mappings may become stale when processes move or stop.

## Worked scenario

A client caches the address of the catalogue service. That instance is replaced before the cache entry expires.

## Discussion

How should the client react when its cached address no longer works?

## Recap

Naming hides location changes only when lookup and recovery behaviour are defined.
